_meta.purpose: Phase 0 yardstick for the college baseball sim. Every sim run is graded against this file. Do not edit values by feel; change only with a new source and a note in PHASE0_NOTES.md.

confidence_key.A: direct from official/primary source, complete season
confidence_key.B: computed from a primary source table (e.g. mean across conferences)
confidence_key.C: derived from a sample (e.g. one conference) or trend-extrapolated; replace in Phase 1 data pull
confidence_key.D: placeholder estimate; must be replaced before the gate that uses it

league_totals_2025._note: Unweighted mean across all 29 conferences + Oregon State (independent). Weighting by team count will move these slightly; recompute from full team table in Phase 1.

era.src: derived: R/G 6.75 x ~0.89 earned share; only 12 of 303 teams had ERA < 4.00 in 2025

pa_per_team_game.src: back-solved from ~34.5 AB + BB + HBP + SF + SH per game in ACC 2025

k_per_9.src: trend 7.88 (2018) plus K% growth; ACC 2025 staffs 9.0-11.1

league_totals_by_tier_2025._note: Use these when validating a conference-tier subset. P4 = ACC, SEC, Big 12, Big Ten, Oregon State. 'mid' and 'low' are rough groupings, see PHASE0_NOTES.md.

pa_outcome_table_league_avg._note: Per plate appearance. Derived to be internally consistent with league_totals_2025 (BA .280 / OBP .385 / SLG ~.445 / HR 1.05 per 38.5 PA). This is Phase 1's single outcome table. conf C until re-fit to full play-by-play.

pitch_level_2023_2025._note: Trackman D1 aggregate (4.56M pitches, Feb 2023 onward) via SABR-Tooth Tigers; count-state data 2013-19 via rfrey22. Used in Phase 5 only.

pitches_per_pa.src: MLB is 3.9; college assumed similar. Replace with Trackman/PBP count.

historical_trend._note: NCAA official 'Division I Baseball Statistics Trends' (per team per game). Use to sanity-check era settings and to build a 'dead-bat' or 'gorilla-ball' preset. conf A.

era_markers.2020s: record HR rates, older rosters post-COVID, 20-round draft

pitching_distribution_2025._note: For Phase 2 leaderboard gate. Among 882 D1 pitchers with >= 50 IP in 2025.

batting_distribution_2025._note: For Phase 2 leaderboard gate. Qualified = 1 PA per team game (B-Ref standard). Fill in from stats.ncaa.org individual leaders in Phase 1 data pull.

typical_games_played.note: some northern/low-budget programs play 40 or fewer

game_structure.weekend_series: Fri-Sat-Sun 3-game series in conference play; midweek 1-2 non-conference games

extra_innings_tiebreaker.value: runner-on-second rule is conference-optional in NCAA; not universal

run_distribution_per_team_game.note: compute histogram P(0),P(1),...,P(15+) from PBP in Phase 1; required for gate

roster_rules_2025_26._note: Post House v. NCAA settlement (approved June 2025, effective July 1, 2025). conf A unless noted.

opt_in_schools.scholarship_type: any mix of full/partial up to roster cap

non_opt_in_schools.note: 54 D1 schools did not opt in as of 2025-26

roster_rules_2025_26.designated_student_athletes: players rostered 2024-25 or promised a 2025-26 spot are grandfathered and do not count against 34

eligibility.note: COVID extra-year cohort largely expired by 2025

transfer_portal_window.2026: June 1 - June 30 (day after MCWS completion also opens)

mlb_draft.note: juniors, seniors, and 21-year-old sophomores eligible; HS signees also lost to the draft
